name: LetsGo Paseo de Gracia
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at LetsGo Paseo de Gracia. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Apartament Paseo de Gracia offers self-catering accommodation with free Wi-Fi in the heart of Barcelona, just 40 metres from Plaza Catalunya. Barcelona’s La Rambla is 5 minutes’ walk away.

These modern apartments feature stylish dècor and come with 1 or 2 bedrooms and a bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries. Their living areas include flat-screen satellite TV and sofas. Their kitchenettes are equipped with a microwave, washing machine and dishwasher.  Some come with a terrace.

Centrally located, you will find many bars, restaurants and supermarkets in the surrounding streets.

Direct buses to Barcelona Airport depart from Plaza Catalunya and Sagrada Familia is 2.5 km from Apartament Paseo de Gracia. A 25-minute walk will take you to Barceloneta Beach.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.9 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

policies.content: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type. Please check what conditions may apply to each option when making your selection.

policies.title: Refundable damage deposit
policies.content: A damage deposit of € 150 is required on arrival. That's about US$175. This will be collected as a cash payment. You should be reimbursed on check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full in cash, subject to an inspection of the property.

policies.title: Children and beds
policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 2 years Cot upon request Prices for cots are not included in the total price, and will have to be paid for separately during your stay. The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.

hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Located on the Paseo de Gracia, all apartments are faced toward the beautifull patio on the inside of the building. two of them have a terreace. Very hard to find in the centre of Barcelona. No traffic noise at all and 50 meters from the Plaza Catalunya where you will find all principal metro/tube stations as well as the special "Aerobus". The Apple Store and Adidas are your neighbours.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: I love to practice outdoor sports like sea swimming in the Barceloneta, running and biking.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Passeig de Gracia - Paseo de Gracia - is Barcelona's most famous shopping street. It is the most expensive street in Barcelona and in Spain and Barcelona's most elegant and fashionable shopping street with all the top designer brands

The Passeig de Gracia starts at Plaza Catalunya and ends at Gracia and is a lovely stroll at any time of year. It is not a long street and and so don't miss a stroll down this famous boulevard. If you want a break take a seat one one of the 32 lovely modernist trencadis benches which also are the base of street lamps which were designed by modernist architecht Pere Falqués i Urpí in 1906.

Highlights of this famous boulevard are the Gaudi modernist creations "Casa Batllo" and "La Pedrera" and also open to the public don't miss modernist Casa Amatller. There are several top restaurants on Passeig de Gracia in hotels Casa Fuster, Hotel Omm with Michelin starred Restaurant Moo, Hotel Oriental Mandarin with Michelin restaurant Moments. The Passeig de Gracia is fabulous for shopping any day, but Christmas shopping is a treat. Christmas in Barcelona and on Passeig de Gracia opens with the Barcelona Shopping Night event every year at the start of Dec.
